summary: Decent Holding Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on July 14, 2026. Shareholders approved proposals to increase authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$2,500,000 by creating additional Class A and Class B ordinary shares, authorize a share consolidation at a ratio between 1-for-10 and 1-for-250, and adopt an amended memorandum and articles of association. The meeting was routine corporate governance; no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation was involved. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or premium were stated.
